TYPE CHECK: The candidate value contains names of immortalized cell lines, which matches the field definition.
SOURCE CHECK: The paper describes a SILAC-MS/MS experiment using "WT and ΔEMC cells". The "Materials and Methods" section specifies that these cell lines were generated using "U2OS Flp-In™ T-Rex™" cells. While "Flp-In™ T-Rex™ 293" and "A673" are mentioned in the "Cell culture" section, the SILAC-MS/MS specific section and the results regarding the proteomic analysis of ΔEMC5 and ΔEMC6 lines refer to the U2OS-derived lines. A673 and HEK293 (Flp-In T-Rex 293) were used for western blotting and immunofluorescence validation of SQS expression, not for the MS experiment.
TRUTH CHECK: Only U2OS Flp-In™ T-Rex™ was used for the actual proteomics (SILAC-MS/MS) experiment. The other two cell lines were used for validation assays.
COMPLETENESS CHECK: The full set includes cell lines that were not used for the MS analysis.
